title: First acceptance of electrode_current_injection@1: Rm1 on the uncleaved egg against R-full
status: registered by the lead on main, 12 November 2026, before the judged run. The development observations below (1 ms and 0.5 ms) were seen before registration; the tolerance rule follows the v2 note and is not chosen from them

definition_source.egg: validation/division/cleft_egg_reference.py build(declared inputs, scalar_values(declared inputs), p_old = the record's p_old_m_s): R-full's own uncleaved egg, written as resolved_pump_tissue@3 by injection_rm1.definition
definition_source.electrode: one electrode in the egg; J1's rm_definition pulse protocol (3e-8 A, 1.2 s, every 10 s, alternating from t = 0 positive) and carrier fractions rm_definition.injected_carrier_fractions (K 0.4912, Cl 0.5088), the field R-full's Pulses read

declared_differences: The engine's ideal concentrations equal R-full's compositions, which are activities (the activity basis).
The initial charge anchor uses the engine's charge per fmol (N_A e) where R-full uses its rounded F: a 3.4e-11 relative difference, as egg_scale_smoke.
The cytosol volume converts m3 to pL with a 1.3e-16 relative rounding (field comparison: /mnt/workspaces/Cells/composite-v2-20261112-01/rm1-draft/compare.json).
observable: Rm1 = (|dV_0| + |dV_1|) / (2 x 3e-8 A), dV_k = V(t_k + 1.0 s) - V(t_k), V the egg's membrane voltage (J1 rm_rule, rm1_pulse_pair 0, 1)
engine_step_term_rule: |Rm1(1 ms) - Rm1(0.5 ms)|, development runs from a clean snapshot of 60d40de
reference_term_rule: max |Rm1 - record| over R-full's integrator variants (Radau rtol 1e-8, BDF rtol 1e-10, LSODA rtol 1e-10)

development_observations.note: Second order; the 1 ms error of 298.5 Ohm is about 4/3 of the step difference. The tolerance detects an engine-to-reference offset above roughly 375 Ohm.

judged_run: once, after registration, from a clean execution snapshot of main (validation/source_snapshot.py; no dirty patch); the driver refuses an unregistered protocol and a run outside a clean snapshot
